'''Seripas's armor''' or '''Seripas's armored suit''' was a mechanized suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] utilized by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]] when he was affiliated with [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] and her band of bounty hunters. It was used to conceal Seripas's small stature and look intimidating,<ref name="bh" /> as well as to boast a powerful circular saw and double-barrelled repeating [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].

==History==
In Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="annual" /> it was destroyed when a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] shot at it as [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]] was [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|defending]] a small [[Akira/Legends|farming village]] with his fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] allies.<ref name="bh">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref>
